## Repetición de Resultados

Este análisis intenta reproducir los resultados del artículo [*Smartphones Undermine Social Connectedness More in Men Than Women: A Mini Mega-Analysis*](https://psycnet.apa.org/fulltext/2024-48810-001.pdf) mediante los script de análisis y los datos publicados en [osf.io/x73m9](https://osf.io/x73m9/files/osfstorage) y también verificar el cumplimiento del pre-registro realizado en [osf.io/je4sm](https://osf.io/je4sm/overview)

### Bibliotecas necesarias

Este script usa la biblioteca *haven* para la importación de archivos de datos .sav.

```{r}
#| echo: false
if(!require(haven))  {install.packages("haven")}
if(!require(tidyverse))  {install.packages("tidyverse")}
if(!require(lm.beta))  {install.packages("lm.beta")}
#if(!require(psych))  {install.packages("psych")}
#if(!require(nlme))  {install.packages("nlme")}
#if(!require(psychometric))  {install.packages("psychometric")}
#if(!require(readr)) {install.packages("readr")}
#if(!require(reghelper)) {install.packages("reghelper")}
#if(!require(plyr))  {install.packages("plyr")}
#if(!require(sjPlot))  {install.packages("sjPlot")}
#if(!require(emmeans))  {install.packages("emmeans")}
#if(!require(MuMIn))  {install.packages("MuMIn")}
#if(!require(EMAtools))  {install.packages("EMAtools")}
if(!require(effectsize))  {install.packages("effectsize")}

```

### Importación de Datos

```{r}
mega_analysis <- read_sav("articles/x73m9-osfstorage-archive-mega/MegaAnalysisMaster.sav")
tech_directions <- read_sav("articles/x73m9-osfstorage-archive-mega/Tech_Directions_Tight.sav")

head(mega_analysis)
```

```{r}
head(tech_directions)
```

```{r}
### Conversión de variables cualitativas a factores
mega_analysis$Gender <- as.factor(mega_analysis$Gender)
mega_analysis$Has_Phone <- as.factor(mega_analysis$Has_Phone)

mega_analysis$Gender <- recode_factor(mega_analysis$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
mega_analysis$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(mega_analysis$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")

mega_analysis$ParadigmsCombined_Factor <- recode_factor(mega_analysis$ParadigmsCombined, `1` = "Tech Directions", `2` = "Tech Restraunt", `3` = "Waiting Alone", `4` = "Waiting Together", `5` = "Parent Study", `6` = "Lunch Study")

mega_analysis_graphs <- subset(mega_analysis, Gender == "Female" | Gender == "Male")
mega_analysis_graphs <- subset(mega_analysis_graphs, Has_Phone == "No Phone"|  Has_Phone == "Phone")


tech_directions$Gender <- as.factor(tech_directions$Gender)
tech_directions$Has_Phone <- as.factor(tech_directions$Has_Phone)
tech_directions$Gender <- recode_factor(tech_directions$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
tech_directions$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(tech_directions$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")
```

## Replicación de Resultados del Informe
### Numero de observaciones
```{r}
model_data <- mega_analysis[, c("SocialConnection_Std", "Age", "Has_Phone", "Gender", "ParadigmsCombined_Factor")]
print(data.frame(
  todos=c(nrow(model_data)),
  casos_completos=c(sum(complete.cases(model_data))),
  casos_incompletos=c(sum(!complete.cases(model_data)))))

```
### Tabla 2

```{r}
mega_analysis_complete <- mega_analysis[complete.cases(mega_analysis[, c("SocialConnection_Std", "Age", "Has_Phone", "Gender", "ParadigmsCombined_Factor")]),]
contrasts(mega_analysis_complete$ParadigmsCombined_Factor) = contr.sum(6)

SocInitial <- lm(SocialConnection_Std ~Age + Has_Phone*Gender +Has_Phone*ParadigmsCombined_Factor, mega_analysis_complete)
modelo_ini_resumen <- summary(SocInitial)
modelo_ini_betas <- lm.beta::lm.beta(SocInitial)
modelo_ini_ci <- confint(SocInitial)

tabla2 <- data.frame(
                     beta=round(modelo_ini_betas$standardized.coefficients,2),
                     b=round(modelo_ini_resumen$coefficients[,"Estimate"],2),
                     b_ic_low=round(modelo_ini_ci[,1],2), 
                     b_ic_high=round(modelo_ini_ci[,2],2), 
                     t=round(modelo_ini_resumen$coefficients[,"t value"],2))

rownames(tabla2) <- c(
  "(Intercept)", 
  "Age", 
  "Condition (phone=1, no-phone=0)", 
  "Gender (man=1, woman=0)",
  "Getting directions",
  "Strong ties meal",
  "Waiting alone",
  "Waiting together",
  "Parents with children",
  "Condition x Gender",
  "Condition x Getting directions",
  "Condition x Strong ties meal",
  "Condition x Waiting alone",
  "Condition x Waiting together",
  "Condition x Parents with children")
print(tabla2)
```

```{r}
nrow(mega_analysis)
colnames(mega_analysis)
nrow(mega_analysis[, c("SocialConnection_Std", "Age", "Has_Phone", "Gender", "ParadigmsCombined_Factor")])

```
